model_io.model: Sb-reconstructed Au(111) surface with (14×14) and Rec(3×√3) periodicities

hypotheses.hypothesis: Interplay of Umklapp scattering and Sb–Au hybridization shapes electronic structure in reconstructed state
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; reciprocal-space folding and Au d-band redistribution observed dependent on reconstruction stage

title: Interplay between structure, phase transition, and molecular dynamics in the organic–inorganic hybrid [N(C2H5)4]2ZnCl4
task: Characterization of structure, phase transition, and molecular dynamics in [N(C₂H₅)₄]₂ZnCl₄
key_results: First-order phase transition at 231 K with thermal hysteresis; tetragonal crystalline phase; thermal stability to ~580 K; phase transition driven by carbon site symmetry changes
comments: Comprehensive multi-technique analysis clearly identifying the phase transition mechanism, though microscopic origin of symmetry change deserves deeper theoretical interpretation.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Phase transition originates from changes in local symmetry around ¹³C sites rather than ¹H or ¹⁴N environments
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; ¹³C resonance lines split below Tc due to nonequivalent sites, coalesce above Tc
